The '''Silvestri system''' was located within the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="Western Reaches" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Silvestri Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="GAtORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Silvestri [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which erroneously named it "Sivestri system" and placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book later corrected the system's name.<ref name="EAOC" />
